## Requirements (from the contract)

1. Specify the additive native `evidence-package/1` profile and owner-typed
   closure interface, immutable coordinates, access/loss/procedure verdicts
   and unknown-version behavior; bind every producer export reference to its
   lower owner; return the proposal to the common amendment register — the
   row-3 packet (AC-1).
2. Negative: no stand-alone receipt authority, no reverse dependency to
   bench/results, no hash-regex reference discovery, no legacy byte rewrite,
   no implied public closure; every required/optional field and historical
   prefix behavior explicitly reviewable (AC-2).
3. Ownership/evidence: no primary ownership (contributing slice only) —
   contributing REQ-E-210 + REQ-H-004 predicates/aliases resolved to numbered
   checks + actual evidence in the coverage register; achieved D/E recorded
   separately from owed R/P / actual-execution E; row-3 REQ-F-001–008 +
   REQ-E-208 primary owners (R5.21–R5.27, GATE-G9) named as evidence
   dependencies, never discharged (AC-3).
4. Scoped verification: docs-only battery — living-docs/row/link checks +
   dossier checker fails-without; exact commands and counts (AC-4).
5. Universal phase gate: verification green in scope; REQ ids stamped in PR;
   deferrals for owed predicates; ADR(s) for owned deviations/decisions;
   run/PR/BUILD_INDEX/LEDGER agree; operating clauses O-01–O-08; invariants
